name: HeLa USD
oneLiner: HLUSD is the HeLa ecosystem's centralized dollar stablecoin, backed by fiat and fiat-equivalent reserves and used as the HeLa runtime settlement asset.
collateral: Fiat and fiat-equivalent reserve assets supporting the HeLa ecosystem's HLUSD stablecoin at a one U.S. dollar target
pegMechanism: Issuer- and ecosystem-managed stablecoin used as the HeLa runtime settlement asset, with external pricing and market-cap coverage supplied by CoinGecko

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: HLUSD is managed by the HeLa ecosystem and its native chain is not yet modeled in Pharos contracts; available sources do not prove a direct holder blacklist path, so admin-control risk is retained as possible.

notices.title: Native chain not yet supported
notices.message: CoinGecko lists HLUSD without a supported Pharos contract platform. Runtime coverage uses the CoinGecko price and market-cap path while contract coverage remains intentionally absent.
